{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Pascagoula Supply Line''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://prnewswire.com/news-releases/williams-partners-lp--florida-gas-transmission-receive-ferc-approval-to-connect-with-gulf-lng-import-terminal-98919609.html|title=prnewswire.com|website=prnewswire.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Mobile Bay Lateral, Alabama to Bayou Casotte, Pascagoula, Mississippi.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://prnewswire.com/news-releases/williams-partners-lp--florida-gas-transmission-receive-ferc-approval-to-connect-with-gulf-lng-import-terminal-98919609.html|title=prnewswire.com|website=prnewswire.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Co LLC; Florida Gas Transmission Co LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://prnewswire.com/news-releases/williams-partners-lp--florida-gas-transmission-receive-ferc-approval-to-connect-with-gulf-lng-import-terminal-98919609.html|title=prnewswire.com|website=prnewswire.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/industries-data/natural-gas/approved-major-pipeline-projects-1997-present|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''810,000 Dth/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://prnewswire.com/news-releases/williams-partners-lp--florida-gas-transmission-receive-ferc-approval-to-connect-with-gulf-lng-import-terminal-98919609.html|title=prnewswire.com|website=prnewswire.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''15.54 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://prnewswire.com/news-releases/williams-partners-lp--florida-gas-transmission-receive-ferc-approval-to-connect-with-gulf-lng-import-terminal-98919609.html|title=prnewswire.com|website=prnewswire.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''26 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://prnewswire.com/news-releases/williams-partners-lp--florida-gas-transmission-receive-ferc-approval-to-connect-with-gulf-lng-import-terminal-98919609.html|title=prnewswire.com|website=prnewswire.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://prnewswire.com/news-releases/williams-partners-lp--florida-gas-transmission-receive-ferc-approval-to-connect-with-gulf-lng-import-terminal-98919609.html|title=prnewswire.com|website=prnewswire.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2011<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$59,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://prnewswire.com/news-releases/williams-partners-lp--florida-gas-transmission-receive-ferc-approval-to-connect-with-gulf-lng-import-terminal-98919609.html|title=prnewswire.com|website=prnewswire.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
